description: This bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline (pink), Source Info (yellow), and Direct Command (light blue)—across three different AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The horizontal axis categorizes the models, listed from left to right as GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," is scaled linearly from 3.5 to 6.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. For each model, three grouped bars represent the entropy values for each method: for GPT-4, the Baseline bar reaches approximately 5.0, the Source Info bar reaches approximately 5.4, and the Direct Command bar reaches approximately 5.4; for Claude, the Baseline bar reaches approximately 5.2, the Source Info bar reaches approximately 5.7, and the Direct Command bar reaches approximately 5.7; for Llama, the Baseline bar reaches approximately 5.4, the Source Info bar reaches approximately 5.8, and the Direct Command bar reaches approximately 5.9. The bars are grouped side-by-side for each model, with no sorting or emphasis applied to any particular bar or group.
